name: diviskit-agent
description: AI agent skills for building pages and layouts on WordPress sites running Divi 5. Ships the Diviskit harness primer (envelope, handshake, dry-run contract), the diviskit-builder skill (verified Divi 5 block formats, presets, theme builder, design systems, WebGL effects via Diviskit Design Library), and the diviskit-scf skill (Secure Custom Fields / ACF automation). Requires the diviskit-agent WordPress plugin and the @diviskit/mcp-server MCP server.
